command:
set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; T=/tmp/aicall-cycle20-telemetry.jsonl; TO=/tmp/aicall-cycle20-telemetry.out; rm -f "$T" "$TO"; state(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 'mCallState=' | cut -d= -f2 | tr -d '[:space:]'; }; voice_block(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio | sed -n '/- STREAM_VOICE_CALL:/,/Volume Group: AUDIO_STREAM_VOICE_CALL/p'; }; BT_BEFORE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '[:space:]'); cleanup(){ [ -n "${TPID:-}" ] && kill "$TPID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; if [ "$BT_BEFORE" = 1 ]; then adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd bluetooth_manager enable >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; for i in $(seq 1 40); do [ "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '[:space:]')" = 1 ] && break; sleep 0.25; done; fi; }; trap cleanup EXIT; test "$(state)" = 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A -o USER,PID,NAME | grep -E '^shell[[:space:]]+[0-9]+[[:space:]]+shizuku_server$'; if [ "$BT_BEFORE" = 1 ]; then adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd bluetooth_manager disable; fi; for i in $(seq 1 40); do [ "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '[:space:]')" = 0 ] && break; sleep 0.25; done; test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '[:space:]')" = 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 || true; PRE=$(voice_block); printf '%s
' "$PRE" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; printf '%s
' "$PRE" | grep -q 'streamVolume:0'; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" dial 510100100; ACTIVE=0; for i in $(seq 1 40); do S=$(state); echo live_call_state=$S; if [ "$S" = 2 ]; then ACTIVE=1; break; fi; sleep 1; done; test "$ACTIVE" = 1; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 || true; ACTIVE_AUDIO=$(voice_block); printf '%s
' "$ACTIVE_AUDIO" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; printf '%s
' "$ACTIVE_AUDIO" | grep -q 'streamVolume:0'; printf '%s
' "$ACTIVE_AUDIO" | grep -q 'Devices: earpiece(1)'; echo silent_audio_guard_active=true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "sh -c 'sleep 25; input keyevent KEYCODE_ENDCALL; cmd audio adj-mute 0; cmd audio adj-mute 8' >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null &"; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge; PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 scripts/s22_resource_telemetry.py --serial "$SERIAL" watch "$T" --duration-seconds 20 --interval-seconds 0.2 >"$TO" 2>&1 & TPID=$!; START_OUTPUT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge/.DiagnosticProbeActivity --ez run_shizuku_cycle_probe true --ei cycle_count 20 2>&1); printf '%s
' "$START_OUTPUT"; printf '%s
' "$START_OUTPUT" | grep -q 'Status: ok'; RESULT=''; for i in $(seq 1 160); do RESULT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v raw -s AiCallBridge:I '*:S' 2>/dev/null || true); if printf '%s
' "$RESULT" | grep -q 'cycle_probe_ok=true'; then break; fi; sleep 0.1; done; printf '%s
' "$RESULT"; printf '%s
' "$RESULT" | grep -q 'completed_cycles=20'; printf '%s
' "$RESULT" | grep -q 'first_failed_cycle=0'; printf '%s
' "$RESULT" | grep -q 'service_pid_stable=true'; printf '%s
' "$RESULT" | grep -q 'final_prepared=false'; printf '%s
' "$RESULT" | grep -q 'final_active=false'; printf '%s
' "$RESULT" | grep -q 'final_heartbeat=false'; printf '%s
' "$RESULT" | grep -q 'cycle_probe_ok=true'; test "$(state)" = 2; sleep 1; kill "$TPID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; wait "$TPID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; TPID=''; test -s "$T"; echo cycle20_probe_green=true; cleanup; trap - EXIT; for i in $(seq 1 20); do [ "$(state)" = 0 ] && break; sleep 0.25; done; test "$(state)" = 0; test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '[:space:]')" = "$BT_BEFORE"; echo cycle20_cleanup_green=true
